notes: SEC-seq: MG1655 in LB to OD 2.0 (early stationary), lysate fractionated by size exclusion chromatography. Fractions 01-20 are column fractions (assay other, exclude); only the cleared-lysate sample (Fraction_00L) is whole-cell RNA, labelled total_rnaseq with no rRNA removal (library by fragmentation and adapter ligation). All samples come from the same untreated wild-type culture, so all are controls. WT re-read: unmodified baseline strain relabelled wild_type.

base_medium.q: 100-fold diluted in 100 ml of fresh LB medium, grown to an OD600 of 2.0

treatment.q: Overnight cultures of E. coli MG1655 were 100-fold diluted in 100 ml of fresh LB medium, grown to an OD600 of 2.0

inducer_added.q: Overnight cultures of E. coli MG1655 were 100-fold diluted in 100 ml of fresh LB medium, grown to an OD600 of 2.0

transcription_arrested.q: Overnight cultures of E. coli MG1655 were 100-fold diluted in 100 ml of fresh LB medium, grown to an OD600 of 2.0

is_control.q: Overnight cultures of E. coli MG1655 were 100-fold diluted in 100 ml of fresh LB medium, grown to an OD600 of 2.0

assay_class.q: Each fraction was automatically collected using fraction collector F9-R at 4°C.
the lysate RNA was extracted by TRIzol method

rrna_removal.q: RNA samples were fragmented, ligated with 3’ adapter, and reverse-transcribed
